extra:
## This work (Р-251, English works series, one at a time)

Source: the English original `london-3-mythos-london-en` (text layer; `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show london-3-mythos-london-en <page>`; page image `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py image london-3-mythos-london-en <physical page> --physical`). Page numbers: `pagemap` often misses printed numbers in these PDFs — look at 2–3 page images and find printed vs physical; in `sources` give the printed page as printed (null for unnumbered pages). Offset is set (printed = physical). Do NOT edit `pipeline/source/books.json` — report any other offset (physical = printed − offset, e.g. «p. 3» on physical 4 → offset −1) and the lead sets it.
Russian text — our translation (flag `translated`); official Russian forms of names and terms — glossary `python -B tools/terms.py <word>` and existing records (Р-184), e.g. Dreamlands = «Страна грёз»; Hard/Extreme roll = «трудная/чрезвычайная проверка» (official «трудный/чрезвычайный успех», never «сложная»). New terms of this book — choose one Russian form each, use it everywhere, and list them all in your report (English → Russian); the translator of the book will reuse exactly these forms.
- FIRST: check that this scenario is not already in the base under a Russian translation (Grep key character and place names, transliterated, in `kb/books/*-ru/`; e.g. «The Haunted Clubhouse» was already there as «Маленький клуб ужасов»). If it is — do NOT create a second set: per Р-147 the translation keeps the text, the original gives the numbers; write proposals to the translation records (English sources, `name.en`, errata for translation errors) and report.
- 1920s London: era 1920s. A collection of three scenarios split into 3 units — see «Shared scheme» below.
- One `scenario` record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene (`arc`), characters (stat blocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters with role `pregen`; unnamed crowds — group profile with invented `names`, Р-151), creatures (known Mythos creatures and deities → `instance_of` the shared record, Grep `kb/creatures` first; a unique being — book record), organizations, items and clues, tomes and spells (known spells → refs to the shared `coc:spell:*`), handouts (text as printed + our full translation), places (a real city — the shared record `coc:location:<city>` if it exists (Grep first), book places `part_of` it; a fictional town — a book place with its places `part_of` it; do not create shared records in `kb/locations/`), maps (`map` records with a spot on every printed label, Р-206; every key number without a record gets a small place record).
- Helper scripts — only in your own scratchpad subfolder `gen-london3` (other helpers run in parallel and use the same scratchpad).
- Book-scoped ids `london-3-mythos-london-en/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/london-3-mythos-london-en/<kinds>/`.
- Pictures (skill `.claude/skills/kb-art/SKILL.md`, Р-241, Р-245): portraits, creature art, handouts, item pictures, maps — mapping `checks/20261116-london3/art.json`, `python -B pipeline/art/add_images.py … --dry-run` then real; apply the proposals yourself (`pipeline/integrate/apply.py`) — you own this book; atmosphere pictures (cover, decoration, mood art not tied to a record) → `checks/20261116-london3/atmosphere.json` (the lead merges it). File prefix for pictures: `london3-`.
- Lessons from earlier checks (skill kb-import, «Ошибки, которые уже находили»): every page of an entry in `sources`; handout texts in full; maps are `map` records, not atmosphere; no two records with the same `name.ru`; terms inside text agree with the record names; book misprints kept as printed, in `errata`, with the obvious ones fixed in `corrections`.
- When done, run `python -I -B tools/completeness.py --books london-3-mythos-london-en --out checks/20261116-london3/completeness` and `python -I -B tools/scenario_check.py --books london-3-mythos-london-en --out checks/20261116-london3/scenario` and fix what they find; then `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/london-3-mythos-london-en` — 0 errors.
- Coverage: in `checks/20261116-london3/london3.md` list every heading of the book → the record that holds it (or «не взято» with the reason), misprints, and the term list (English → Russian).

## Shared scheme of this book (3 units work in parallel — keep to it exactly)

A collection (Cubicle 7, Cthulhu Britannica: London, 2014) of three independent 1920s London scenarios; each is its own `scenario` record with its own scenes. 1920s: era `1920s`; London places `part_of` the shared `coc:location:london` (exists; do not edit it — Grep `kb/locations` and `kb/books/*` for an existing record of a real London place, e.g. Soho in `masks-of-nyarlathotep-en`, before creating one; a book place may `part_of` another book's place).
- Ids: `london-3-mythos-london-en/scenario/terror-on-the-thames`, `london-3-mythos-london-en/scenario/those-poor-souls-who-dwell-in-light`, `london-3-mythos-london-en/scenario/the-non-euclidean-gate`; scenes `london-3-mythos-london-en/scene/<thames|poor-souls|gate>-<slug>`; other records — slug of the English name; if two scenarios share a real place (e.g. the Thames), the unit of the earlier scenario owns it and the other refers to it by `london-3-mythos-london-en/location/<slug>` (dangling until it exists — list it in your report).
- The «Appendix: 6th Edition Stats» (p. 84–90) duplicates the 7e stat blocks in 6th-edition form: do not import it as records; each unit notes in its coverage file which appendix pages belong to its scenario («не взято — статы 6-й редакции, дубль»). «List of Backers» and «Index» (p. 91–96): unit gate notes them as «не взято» with the reason.
- Coverage file `checks/20261116-london3/london3-<unit>.md` per unit; art mapping `art-<unit>.json`, atmosphere `atmosphere-<unit>.json`, proposals `proposals-<unit>.json`; picture prefix `london3-<unit>-`.
- completeness/scenario_check: every unit runs them at the end on the whole book (others' gaps are expected — report only yours) into `checks/20261116-london3/completeness-<unit>` and `scenario-<unit>`; `python -B tools/check.py kb/books/london-3-mythos-london-en` — 0 errors except dangling refs to the scheme ids above.
